analysis.description: Opening subject and answer entries only, manually transcribed from the score and checked against Saayman's discussion. The rest of the fugue is not represented.

notes: The excerpt covers mm. 1–11. The opening voice is the tenor, followed by alto, soprano and bass. The tenor drops out during the final bass entry, as discussed by Saayman. The later inverted subject is outside this excerpt. Manual reading of the public-domain score, corroborated by Saayman's discussion of entry order and subject design. Quarter-note coordinates are relative to each fugue, not to its prelude. Only the opening exposition is mapped. Entry endpoints mark the subject core; continuing counterpoint and extensions are not automatically included.
